digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows and CI configuration
propositions: Four GitHub Actions workflows (test.yml, optionality.yml, prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yml) must exclude the tickets branch from push-triggered CI by adding 'tickets' to their branches-ignore lists
A new test module must enumerate all workflow files in .github/workflows/ from disk and assert that none push-match the tickets branch, preventing silent regressions if workflows are added later

Adopter-facing documentation must warn that rebar's auto-push on every write triggers CI for the tickets branch unless explicitly filtered, with canonical guidance in docs/concurrency.md and cross-links in docs/user-guide.md and docs/config.md
All schedule cron expressions and gerrit-verify.yaml (dispatch-only) configuration must remain unchanged after the branch-filter modifications
The tickets branch push made after the change merges must produce zero new workflow runs, validated by querying the GitHub Actions API for that push's head SHA
